identity: A small applicator used to mend IPAV armor.  Official UICA doctrine dictates that IPAV armor is rated to survive a single combat encounter, and this kit is only to be used in emergency situations where resupply is not possible.  It contains a single dose of high density polymer gel that can be applied to damaged plates for temporary repair.
